reading:
The judges love this line's system more than any single picture. Every lens credits the band with a head column (a figure over its label, links such as '3 late →'), leader rows that run to tabular facts, WHO/DUE column heads, the NOW divider, 'usually Plans' on the starters, and the 'Also on' index ("the best wayfinding in the heat", interaction). In 14a they also loved one gesture: the white-cored stem that carries Next up's light down into the programme. System and feedback called it the heat's best cross-camp graft, soul gave it 8, and it drew 7 promise votes.

What sank it was the drawing of that stem and the body under it. The stem ran about 500px at right angles across empty ground: "a decorative wire to nowhere" (usability), "a circuit-board trace" (skeptic). Rows sat in filled slate strips, which made it read as "an admin table" (style, skeptic, system, feedback). Five other faults recur:
- The head-column figure floats under its head instead of sitting on the first row's baseline (soul, system, interaction, type).
- The 13rem head column turns into a wall of filter keys on Ideas and To do (skeptic, style, interaction).
- The Plans dial is a third dial style (system, skeptic).
- 'was due' is set in tracked mono (type), and the setup bar is amber (system).
- The Settings section pages still use old filled panels (soul, system, interaction, usability).

The title 'line up.' failed in every note: a vague idiom and a two-word glow block. On the phone the stem also runs behind the starters' text.

To win, it should keep the stem idea but make it a short, honest drop from the tube onto NOW. The rows should lie on page ground like a printed TV listing, with the time in its own column. One left edge and one rail x should run through every band, and the same grammar should reach Plans, To do, Status and Settings. The phosphor kit's light belongs only where it lives (the lit word, the tube, the NOW lamp, the stem, Send). The line also needs a new title.

briefs.name: Listing, Dropped Through
briefs.hypothesis: Listing, Lit Through lost on how the stem was drawn and on the body under it, never on the idea; the stem was 14a's most-praised graft. Three changes answer the most-cited critiques, and none of them adds a new gimmick. (1) The tube moves into Coming up as the listing's featured programme, so the stem is a 28px straight drop from the tube's power lamp onto NOW instead of a 500px jog. (2) The rows leave their slate strips for page ground with hairlines, and the time gets its own column, so the page finally reads as an evening TV listing and not an admin table. (3) One rail x runs from the tube through Coming up and on, faintly, to To do's NOW, so a single lit thread ties the evening together, which feedback asked for. The grafts come from the tour's best-scored finals: Trued's power-wire-and-meter logic, Waypoint's numeral-and-time row, and Lit Manual's numbered parts rail. Each lands inside this line's own head column and rail, so it should read as native. The cut also shortens Home by about 300px (usability asked for that) and brings back the phosphor kit's halo only on the five live things.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-listing-cross's files (sheet.css, palette.css, templates/*). Keep its tokens: bg #0b0e0c, ink #d4cfc4, heading #ebe6da, accent steel #84a0c4, lit sage #86d9a6, brand #6dff9c, the kind hues, and steel reverse #5f7689 with a #a9c4d8 cap for 'here'. Keep the band grammar (a head column, then the body, with one 1px --line rule over each band), the leader rows, the column heads, NOW, 'Also on' and 'usually Plans' on the starters.

TOKENS AND GRID. Add --head-col: 10rem (was 13rem) and --rail-x: 14px, which is measured from the body column's left edge and used by every railed list. The band grid becomes grid-template-columns: var(--head-col) minmax(0,1fr), with a column gap of 2rem.

HOME, desktop:
(a) The greeting, .greet. Keep its rounded glass pool and the kit's top bloom. Its grid becomes minmax(0,1fr) 19rem. The left column holds the Vera line (mark, name, date), the title and the box. The right column holds the three starters stacked as 56px keys, each keeping its 'usually Plans' tag in steel and a 1px --line-2 edge, under an 'Or start with' label in Plex Sans 500, sentence case. The Next up tube leaves the greeting.
(b) Coming up, section.band.coming. Give it the grid template rows 'head tube' / '. now' / 'fig rows'. Make .band-head display:contents, so that h2 'Coming up' sits in the head column level with the tube's top, and the figure '4' over 'PLANS' sits in the row grid area, aligned by baseline with the first row's title (align-self: baseline on both). 'All plans →' goes under the figure.
(c) The tube, .next-tube, sits in the body column's 'tube' area at full body width but capped at height 11rem; do not stretch it. Inside: the left 38% holds the NEXT UP flag, the plan title, 'Sunday 4 October, 13:00' and '[IN 2 DAYS]' in VT323. The right 62% holds the four-week trace, which grows from 28px to 72px pulses. Each pulse becomes an <a> to its plan, with the day numeral under it in VT323 and the next pulse labelled on the glass 'Sun 4 · next'; the key 'A bar is a plan · weekends shaded' goes under the tube in --faint. Drop the radar circle from Home's tube; Ideas keeps its radar. Move the power lamp from the tube's bottom-right corner to its bottom-left, at exactly --rail-x.
(d) The stem, .stem.stem-drop, is a 2px vertical line with a white core and a #6dff9c halo (the kit's two-layer box-shadow 0 0 4px, 0 0 14px). It drops about 28px straight from the power lamp onto the NOW lamp, with no horizontal run and no jog.
(e) The NOW lamp has a white core, a #6dff9c ring and the kit's breathing halo. Below it the rail runs at --rail-x: at full brand strength from NOW to the Next row's ring, then tapering (a linear-gradient to --lit at 45%) to the last row. After Coming up it carries on as a 1px dashed --line-2 at 35% opacity, behind the setup band and the band rules, down to To do's NOW tick, which relights for a 24px lit segment. To do's checkbox column must sit centred on --rail-x so that both rails share one x.
(f) Coming up rows, li.lrow, sit on page ground: background transparent, border-bottom 1px var(--line). The anatomy is: [the ring on the rail] [day numeral, Plex Sans Condensed 300, 2.25rem, ink, tabular] [the stacked 'OCT' over 'SUN', Plex Mono 0.68rem, --label] [the time '13:00', Plex Mono 500 tabular, in its own 4.5rem column, --ink-2] [the title, Plex Sans 600, --heading] [a dotted leader] ['in 2 days', Plex Sans, --dim]. The 'NEXT' flag stays in brand as tracked caps. Hover is a 12% steel wash (color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent)) with inset 2px 0 0 var(--lit), on at once and fading out over 1s.
(g) The setup band keeps its one strip, its ringed steps 1-2-3 and 'Next: choose your own password →'. Its left bar changes from amber to a 3px bone --ink-2 bar, the '3 left' figure becomes --heading, and the rings stay steel with step one lit sage. Amber is now kept for late only.
(h) To do rows go onto page ground the same way. 'was due 5 days ago' is set in Plex Sans 500 at #ffb850, preceded by a 0.6em ▲ (.tri, a CSS triangle). There is no amber edge and no amber outline. Only the relative figure may be mono, and not even that by default.
(i) Lately added and 'Also on' go to page ground too. The 32px kind tiles lose their fills: the icon is drawn in its kind hue on a 1px --line-2 square, and the kind word keeps its hue. This holds the colour share, so name these hues as the replacement for the slate that goes.

HOME, phone (390px). The order is: the Vera line, the title on two lines ('Put it on / Vera's list.'), the box, the starters as three stacked 48px keys, then the Coming up head, the tube (text above the trace, at 15rem tall), the 28px stem, NOW and the rows. The NEXT UP title must show inside the first 844px. The stem now lives inside the band, so it can no longer run behind the starters (14a's z-index fault). Check this in the shot.

IDEAS. The page head row is: the title 'Ideas' with its icon inline at the title's x (28px, kind-violet stroke), the sentence under it, the green 'Add an idea' button, and the landscape radar tube at right, which is kept. The head column (10rem) holds the figure '12' over 'IDEAS', set on the first row's baseline. Under it the KIND index is set as a listing index: one 36px line per kind with a 16px icon in its hue, the name, a dotted leader and the count in Plex Mono, for example 'Activity ···· 2'. The latched kind is a steel reverse row. This replaces the two-up grid of grey keys. 'For' and 'How far along' move out of the head column into the band's head row, above the column heads, as one-tap segmented keys (40px, latched in steel reverse; Anyone · Alex · Maya · Sam · Theo, and All but dropped · Not yet · Done · Dropped). Search stays at full width with its worded 'Search' button. Rows go onto page ground with the same hover.

TO DO. The head column holds the figure '4' over 'OPEN', '3 late →' in amber words (a link to ?late=1), and '+ Add something to do'. Open / Late / Done / Cancelled / All move to the band's head row as a segmented key row, so the head column no longer holds a wall of keys. Search goes at full width above it. The rail and NOW are as on Home, at --rail-x. Each row keeps its 'Edit or snooze' key.

PLANS. Drop the round 'Next in 2 days' dial; it was the third dial style. The head column holds '5' over 'PLANS THIS MONTH', a line 'next in 2 days' with a 6px lit dot, and List / Month as a segmented key pair. The month grid is unchanged, except that event chips lose their slate fill for a 2px plans-cyan left edge on page ground. Today's cell keeps its steel reverse number.

STATUS. The spend dial stays round and stays in the head column of 'What it costs', but it is rebuilt with Trued's meter logic (see borrows). Its scale is the square root of the share of the limit, with ticks labelled 0, .25, 1, 2. The needle is a hot core with a halo and a hub, and a dashed ghost needle rests on the average day ($0.04). Under the glass it reads '$0.00 of $2.00 today' in words, in Plex Sans, so it reads even at zero. The facts rows go onto page ground and run the band's full width. 'Who answers' keeps the chain that is lit only between lamps that are on, with the shape legend under its figure.

SETTINGS, the overview and every section page (General, AI model and the rest). Remove the filled .panel slabs. The head column holds Lit Manual's numbered parts rail (see borrows). The body holds each group under a rule head: an h2 in Plex Sans Condensed 600 at 1.25rem with a 1px --line rule running to the edge. Field labels are Plex Sans 500 sentence case (no tracked mono caps), with help in --dim under each field at a 60ch measure. The sticky Save bar stays.

NEW-IDEA FORM. Put the Title field first in DOM and Tab order, with the kind keys after it. A kind with no mapped icon falls into 'Other'.

PAGE HEADS EVERYWHERE. Remove the floating 44px icon tile from the head column. The section icon goes inline before the title at 28px, in its grounded hue, so the head reads as one unit (type and feedback asked for this).

LIGHT, from phosphor_kit.md, only on: the lit word (the kit's layered text-shadow halo, with only 'list.' lit and the rest of the title in --heading), the Next up tube (bloom, scanlines, its glass blur), the stem and the NOW lamps, Send and the primary buttons, focus rings, and the Status dial's needle. Everything else stays matte.
briefs.borrows:
OWN FIXES, from the dossier, most cited first:
(1) Stem drawn as a straight drop from the tube's foot onto NOW, tapered after NOW, and carried on faintly to To do's NOW. Asked by usability, the skeptic, soul and feedback; system and style asked to keep it.
(2) Rows off the filled slate strips, onto page ground with hairlines and a hover wash. Asked by feedback, style and system.
(3) Head-column figure on the first row's baseline. Asked by soul, system, interaction and type.
(4) Settings section pages onto the page-ground band grammar. Asked by soul, system, interaction and usability.
(5) Head column narrowed to 10rem, and the filter walls on Ideas and To do moved out of it (into the band head row, with kind as a listing index). Asked by interaction, the skeptic and style.
(6) The Plans dial dropped as a third dial style. Asked by system and the skeptic.
(7) 'was due' in Plex Sans amber, not tracked mono. Asked by type.
(8) The setup bar in bone, with amber for late only. Asked by system.
(9) Title before the kind keys in Tab order on the new-idea form. Asked by interaction and usability.
(10) The time in a column of its own, so the TV listing shows. Asked by style.
(11) The page title and its icon joined into one unit. Asked by type and feedback.
(12) A new title. Every lens asked for this.
From earlier rounds: taller trace pulses, labelled and linked (feedback, soul, system, interaction, usability in 13), and Status rows at full measure (type, system).

GRAFTS FROM THE OTHER CAMP:
(A) Trued, Headlamp (x14a-trued-cross).
- Its 'tube as the line's head with a power wire to its stop', rebuilt here as the tube's bottom-left power lamp at --rail-x with a 28px straight stem onto NOW. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-trued-cross/templates/home.html (the Next tube and the track) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-trued-cross/src/headlamp.css.
- Its square-root spend meter with a ghost needle on the average day, a dashed limit tick and a hub, rebuilt inside this line's round head-column dial. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-trued-cross/templates/status.html lines 99-126 (.meter-tube, .needle-ghost, .meter-key) and its sheet.css.
(B) Waypoint, Ruled (x14a-waypoint-cross).
- Its Coming up row anatomy: the big light day numeral with a stacked month/weekday, then the time in its own column before the title. Rebuilt as Plex Sans Condensed 300 numerals with Plex Mono stacks, on page ground, hanging from this line's rail. File: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-waypoint-cross/templates/home.html lines 182-188 (.hop-day, .hop-stack, .hop-time).
- Its ▲ late glyph (.tri) before 'was due' words in a proportional face: home.html line 225 and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-waypoint-cross/templates/tasks.html, with sheet.css. Late is then words, shape and colour, never colour alone.
(C) Lit Manual, Slotted (x14a-manual-cross). Its numbered parts rail on the Settings section pages (numbered rings 1-9 threaded by a 1px rail, the current part lit, every part a 44px row). Here it becomes the Settings head column, and the steel reverse marks the current part. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-manual-cross/templates/settings_section.html (from line 10) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-manual-cross/sheet.css.

WHAT THE LINE KEEPS: the band and head-column grammar, the figure over its caps label, the leader rows, WHO/DUE/KIND/FOR/# heads, NOW, steel reverse for 'here', 'usually Plans', 'Also on', the four-week trace, the Ideas radar, the Status chain and the Status round dial.

WHAT IT GIVES UP to make room: the tube in the greeting's right column, the long right-angled stem, the radar on Home's tube, the Plans dial, the filled slate row strips, the slate fills on kind tiles and month chips, the 13rem column, the kind-key grid and the amber setup bar.
briefs.avoids:
It answers each critique of 14a's design.
- 'A decorative wire to nowhere' and 'a circuit-board trace' (usability, skeptic, soul): the stem is now a 28px straight drop from the tube's lamp to NOW, tapered after NOW.
- 'Filled slate strips feel heavy' and 'reads as an admin table' (feedback, style, system, skeptic): rows lie on page ground with hairlines, and the time has its own column, as in a listing.
- 'Figures float in a 13rem gutter' (skeptic, type, interaction): a 10rem column, with the figure on the first row's baseline.
- 'A wall of filter keys' on Ideas and To do (skeptic, style): kind becomes a listing index, the other filters move to the head row, and there is still one control per filter.
- 'A third dial style' (system): the Plans dial is gone.
- 'Pasted badges' (skeptic): the remaining dial is Status's, rebuilt on Trued's working meter so $0.00 still reads.
- Tracked-mono 'was due' (type): now Plex Sans with ▲.
- An amber bar on setup (system): now bone.
- Old Settings panels (four lenses): page ground with Manual's parts rail.
- Tab order on the new-idea form, the orphan page-head tiles, the 2000px Home and the phone's stem behind the starters.
- The 'line up.' glow block and its vague idiom: a new one-word lit title.

It also follows the 14a lessons. A fix for empty ground shrinks the container: the tube is capped at 11rem, not stretched. Colour is replaced, not removed: the kind hues move into icons and words when the slate goes, with bone for setup and sage for the rail. The grafts are taken in their corrected forms (square ticks, not the ring-as-tick). And there is no shared readout strip or duplicate title, to keep the field from converging.
briefs.title:
"Put it on Vera's *list*." This has not been tried by any design: titles.md and the 14a titles list contain no 'list' title. The lit word is 'list.', with the full stop inside the lit run, the kit's two-layer halo, and the rest set in --heading Plex Sans Condensed.

It says FamilyDB's job plainly. Everything the family hands over ends up on one of its lists: plans, things to do, ideas to keep and the kids' wish lists. So the line takes in a reminder, an idea or a wish as easily as a weekend, which 'plan' titles were faulted for not quite doing. It names who hears you, which judges asked for. It is an imperative that cannot be answered 'no'. It ends on a short four-letter lit word where the eye stops, so the halo stays compact; 'line up' was a two-word glow block. It fits one desktop line and breaks cleanly on the phone ('Put it on / Vera's list.').

It is also this listing line's own voice without being a pun. Unlike 'line up', the lit word is the plain household word for what the family actually keeps, so it gives the field a third distinct title family next to 'plan' and 'needs a plan'.
